def generate_grid():
    N = int(input())
    grid = [[0 for _ in range(N)] for j in range(N)]
    grid[(N+1)//2-1][(N+1)//2-1] = "T"
    dir = [[0, 1], [1, 0], [0, -1], [-1, 0]]
    dirPath = 0
    x = y = 0
    grid[x][y] = 1
    for i in range(2, N**2 + 1):
        while (x + dir[dirPath][0] < 0 or x + dir[dirPath][0] >= N or
               y + dir[dirPath][1] < 0 or y + dir[dirPath][1] >= N or
               grid[x + dir[dirPath][0]][y + dir[dirPath][1]] != 0):
            dirPath = (dirPath + 1) % 4
        x = x + dir[dirPath][0]
        y = y + dir[dirPath][1]
        grid[x][y] = i

    for i in range(N):
        print(*grid[i])
